items.text: Lots of great work in #Maui today speaking w/local health orgs on mental health support for fire survivors, meeting w/impacted businesses to discuss their needs, & touring Lahaina w/community leaders on how my Lahaina National Heritage Area Act can support their recovery efforts! https://t.co/jR6Z7gQdko

Our communities face unique challenges accessing mental health services due to stigma, limited culturally appropriate services, and lack of data in research. Beyond #MinorityMentalHealthMonth, we must address these impacts & act to eliminate health disparities and inequities. https://t.co/lIinDFpkqc

Honored to speak at @HI_PacificAHEC @uhmedjabsom Hawai'i Health Workforce Summit to discuss supporting Maui, reimbursements that reflect our cost of care & retaining our healthcare workers. Mahalo to our medical professionals who support a healthier future for our ‘ohana. ❤️ https://t.co/j1P4w8aiLi

I’m excited to share that @waimanalohealth is receiving $600,000 to expand their behavioral & mental health services! Big mahalo to @HRSAgov for supporting WHC & the dedicated health care workers who make a real difference in our communities. https://t.co/ekS5FUp6tv

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth. This month is a reminder to get annual screenings, support research, & honor survivors. I stand with our ʻohana who fight against this illness & will keep advocating for equitable health care for all. 💗 https://t.co/oJcxQB931V

Happy to speak at Community First's Hawai‘i Healthcare Conference & discuss our work in Congress to increase access to health care. Also ran into @HMHBHawaii & checked out their mobile health clinic. Mahalo for your work with our mothers & babies, & showing me Big Mama! 🚐 https://t.co/oVt7OABu4N

More from my recent trip to Kauaʻi: Visited Kauaʻi Community College to see their health workforce development programs, talk with @YWCAofKAUAI and their Abortion Access Workgroup on challenges, & sat down with @kauaipd on safe firearm disposal for seized weapons. Mahalo! https://t.co/ZRVMdtPIGV

It's #RuralHealthMonth, and as co-chair of the Bipartisan Rural Health Caucus & a proud representative of rural communities, I believe your zipcode should not determine whether you have access to quality health care. Stay tuned for updates on rural health throughout November! https://t.co/jPkUzIksgI

RFK Jr. and President-Elect Trump have committed to an extreme agenda that promises to hamstring our federal health agencies and their essential work to keep Americans safe. Cutting critical investments is not making America healthy again—it's reckless, and leaving us unprepared. https://t.co/fObqtBqKXk

A big mahalo to everyone who joined @RepHarshbarger and I at our Rural Health Caucus Roundtable! Talking to health officials & rural hospital leaders in a bipartisan setting is the only way we will improve health care access for our rural & remote communities across the country. https://t.co/DvyIl84DkH

As co-chair of the Bipartisan Rural Health Caucus, I was proud to lead my colleagues in a Special Order Hour on the House floor recognizing Rural Health Day & highlighting the importance of improving health outcomes and life expectancy in our rural communities. #RuralHealthMonth https://t.co/dWOqAtif7u

Hawaiian Telcom ➕ federal, state, & county partners 🟰 $1.7B to turn Hawai‘i into the first fully fiber-enabled state! ✅

Proud to be a part of this initiative. Whether for health, school, or work—all of our ʻohana deserve internet access, regardless of where they live. https://t.co/qFuPTzjj06

With my Waiʻanae Coast Comprehensive Health Center ʻohana today, here to remind everyone that when we talk about funding for Medicaid, federally qualified health centers, SNAP—these are the faces on the frontline making sure our people are okay. We will continue fighting for you! https://t.co/eK5J3LIDYG

America is staring down the barrel of a $2.5 trillion cut to Medicaid that would affect millions of seniors & our rural communities.

These arenʻt cost savings. These are neighbors, friends, parents, kids.

I'm calling for a rural health moonshot. We can and must fight back. @ruralhealth 

Watch the full speech here:
https://t.co/6ZccJTcybM

As our government gets hacked up, it'll take courage for Republicans to ask whether this is good for the American people & the Constitution. 

I will continue to say "hell no" to blind attacks on federal workers, health care, food assistance, education & critical resources our communities depend on.

Republicans want bullshit tax breaks for billionaires and corporations. Guess how they're paying for it:

By cutting off 82,000 in Hawaiʻi from SNAP, eliminating Medicaid for over 350,000 keiki & kūpuna, and increasing health premiums for over 10,000 Hawaiʻi residents.

Hell no. https://t.co/ypdGXn3nWB

Attacking USPS is the same as attacking lifelines to food and medicine for our rural communities. I stood with @NALC_National  this week to send a clear message to anyone trying to dismantle, privatize, or weaken the Postal Service: If you mess with the mail, we will #FightLikeHell!

Mahalo to @AmerMedicalAssn & @ANANursingWorld for joining our Bipartisan Rural Health Caucus to discuss health workforce shortages in our rural communities. We will continue working across the aisle so all of our people can get the care they deserve! https://t.co/M60h1bKcJM

President Trump & DOGE gutted 36 programs at UH ending research in renewable energy, sustainability & health, all things we desperately need in Hawaiʻi. Worse, they are inciting fear among our international students & talent.

With more cuts to come, this will not make life in Hawaiʻi great or any easier.

With cuts to the @NatlParkService, attacks on natural disaster preparedness & climate science, and this administrationʻs gutting of our country’s environmental & health protections, #EarthDay reminds us to continue fighting for our jobs, our homes, & our planet. Itʻs on us to create a safer, healthier future.

Visited Wahiawa Health to see how crucial Title X funding supports family planning and preventative health services. With these funds now frozen, clinics like Wahiawa are at risk. We must protect Title X to ensure families have access to healthcare and to keep these critical services in tact.

Met with staff at Queen’s Medical Center & toured the newly expanded ER at Punchbowl — set to welcome its first patient soon! Grateful to see how Queen’s is working to expand access to care, including in rural communities & see firsthand the lifesaving work happening in their transplant department.

Proud to stand with advocates, parents, and community leaders from HCIR, Hawaiʻi Foodbank, HCAN, & Hawaiʻi Appleseed to speak out against the devastating cuts in this BIG, UGLY BILL. Our people deserve better than a law that threatens food money, health care, and the future of our keiki and kūpuna.

I asked Ag execs if gutting EPA’s Office of Research and Development helps their industry. Silence. 

President Trump's EPA cuts are yet another political shell game aimed at attacking scientific research and reducing protections for human health. https://t.co/DGVwuBGKDx

Bu & I stopped by KWXX & B97 to chat about my full day on both sides of the Big Island, which included a fireside chat at Kona Community Hospital and a visit with Kumukahi Health in Hilo. Mahalo for providing quality healthcare and support to our communities + teaching me how to clack!
